provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Marks the point a range starts from, in time, space or a scale (九時から, 東京から), and paired with まで it brackets the range by naming its two extremes (子供から大人まで) as illustrations of its width, not exact limits. Two sibling entries take the other readings: the party an action comes from (先生から聞いた) and the speaker's reason for an action (寒いから). より replaces から at the near end in formal writing and announcements (九時より五時まで).

examples.ruby: この本[ほん]は子供[こども]から大人[おとな]まで幅広[はばひろ]く読[よ]まれている。
examples.english: This book is read widely, by everyone from children to adults.

examples.ruby: この駅[えき]は始発[しはつ]から終電[しゅうでん]まで人[ひと]が絶[た]えない。
examples.english: This station never empties out, from the first train to the last.

examples.ruby: 来月[らいげつ]からの新[あたら]しい仕事[しごと]が少[すこ]し不安[ふあん]だ。
examples.english: I'm a little nervous about the new job that starts next month.
